cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You asked if lunch was good. The soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Excellent, but slightly salty. I hadn't finished my lunch review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget lunch. Answer about the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You also asked where we ate. That deserves a precise answer.
